test_title: PYST 63: SSC MTS 2024 - English Language and Comprehension (Held On: 14 Nov, 2024 - Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

We should always ________ our best to help others.
solution:
```html
The correct answer is '**do**'.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
__
 
• The verb "**do**" is the base form of the verb and is appropriate to use with the phrase "We should always" to indicate performing an action.
 
• The sentence is in the present tense, and the auxiliary verb "should" requires the base form of the verb "do" to complete the sentence correctly.
 
• **Options 1, 2**, and 4 are incorrect because they are not in the correct form to match the structure of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.
 
**Complete Sentence:** *"We should always **do**__ our best to help others."*
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "does"** is incorrect because "does" is used with singular third-person subjects (e.g., he, she, it).
 
• **Option 2: "done"** is incorrect because it is the past participle form and cannot be used directly after "should."
 
• **Option 4: "did"** is incorrect because it is the past tense form and does not fit the sentence structure here.

``
